title: Add version command and handle closed stdout pipes cleanly
description: In boreal-work, bwrk --version is an unknown command, and piping bwrk commands --json to head produced an unhandled EPIPE stack trace. Both are common agent and human probes during tool discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk --version and bwrk version --json return stable version/build information.
Large command output handles EPIPE without an unhandled Node stack trace.
Tests cover version output and piping or early-closed stdout behavior.
closedReason: Version command and broken stdout pipe handling are implemented and tested.
